High? Energized? No, I don't get high like that. I mean, sure, I get irritable, but who wouldn't be? See things? Like what, like ghosts or something? Or like, like hallucinations? No, no, absolutely not. I don't see things that aren't there. My eyes work perfectly fine, doctor. Better than fine, actually, because I have to keep them peeled all the time. 

I mean, if you're asking if I see things other people don't see, well, sure, I see the truth! I see what's really going on when everyone else is acting like everything is just perfectly normal. I'll say, \"I know you were in my room on Tuesday because I left a piece of thread on the drawer and it was gone when I got back.\" That's not jumping around, doctor, that's just giving the facts. That's a straight line. \n\nBut you know what they do? They pretend they don't get it. They look at me with these big, fake confused faces, like, \"Oh, what are you talking about?\" or they tell me to calm down because I'm making no sense. But I'm making perfect sense! I'm just telling them the truth, and they don't want to hear it, so they act like I'm the one who can't talk right. It's just another trick. It's a tactic, see? Because if they admit they understand exactly what I'm saying, then they have to admit they're stealing from me. So they play dumb. \n\nI never lose focus. I stay right on the topic, which is my money and my things, and I don't ever lose my train of thought. I don't care about the news, I don't care about the neighbors unless they are helping my family hide my cash. I just sit in my room and guard my stuff. \n\nMy aunt tried to tell me the other day that I am just paranoid about everything in the whole world. And I told her right to her face that I ain't paranoid about the weather, I ain't paranoid about the mailman, I am just watching my wallet! I know exactly what is real and what ain't. Well, yeah. I mean, of course I do. I have to, don't I? Because if I don't take care of myself, nobody else is going to do it for me, especially not them. So, yeah, other than the arguments—because, believe me, we argue about the money all the time, like I said, it's a constant battle—but other than that, I still handle everything I need to. \n\nI make my own meals, for one thing. I don't trust them to cook for me anyway, not with everything going on. So I go to the store, I buy my own food, I bring it back, and I cook it myself. I make sure I know exactly what's going into it. And I eat just fine. I make sure I get my three meals, keep my strength up, because you need your strength when you're dealing with people trying to rob you blind in your own house. \n\nAnd I still get to all my appointments, too. Like, I have to go to the county clinic, right? And the assistance office to deal with my paperwork, since my income dropped and all that. I never miss those.
